name: SendGrid
one_liner: SendGrid is a cloud-based email delivery service that offers a REST API for transactional and marketing emails.
auth_notes: To authenticate, add an HTTP `Authorization` header to your API request that contains an API Key. To use an API key, include an `Authorization` header with the value `Bearer <YOUR_API_KEY_HERE>`.
access_notes: After the 60 day trial period, email send via any web API or SMTP integration for the account will stop unless an appropriate "Email API" plan is chosen.
blocker: trial only, no free tier for credentials

evidence.snippet: The SendGrid v3 Web API provides a REST interface to send email at scale and ensure your application can handle high volumes.
This API reference provides complete documentation for every endpoint and operation.
Production-grade Model Context Protocol server exposing SendGrid's transactional email APIs to AI agents (Cursor, Claude Code, Copilot, Windsurf, Zed).
